OUR CRAFT

Two metals.
No shortcuts.

Every Yonge piece starts as solid 925 sterling silver, then either stays bare or is layered in a thick 18k gold vermeil plate — heavier than standard plating, so it holds its color for years, not months.

Stones are set by hand and chosen for how they catch light against warm gold or cool silver, not just for size. Nothing leaves our bench without a final check under a loupe.

About Yonge

The brand, and the person who built it.

Christopher AdamsFounder & Owner, Forever Yonge Canada Inc.
MEET THE FOUNDER

Built from the
ground up.

Christopher Adams is a Toronto-born entrepreneur and the owner of Forever Yonge Canada Inc., committed to innovation. His jewelry collections are, in many ways, pieces of him — carefully crafted, curated, and inspired by his passions for world travel, culture, family, and community. His travels have given him a global understanding of people, places, and artifacts, and that understanding shows up in every collection he builds.

Having dreamed of leaving his mark on the world, Chris built his company from the ground up. As a child, he was a builder of forts. As a teenager, a creative visionary. As an adult, a leader, a problem solver, and a builder of community. So it's no surprise that he built his first business at the young age of 16.

Yonge Jewelry's story started by matching the needs of young people with experiences that inspired them. Having grown up in the Yonge Street corridor, Chris first began bringing people together through event planning — combining his love of Toronto with an urban energy set on building community. The "live, laugh, love" motto transcended some of the social isolation of the time.

Shortly after, Chris started to source, design, and sell unique jewelry pieces at pop-ups and city markets across Toronto. It wasn't long before he opened his first storefront on Kensington Street, in the heart of Kensington Market — the energy of the people fueling his business and acting as his creative muse.

His is a business of service, one that aims to match customer needs with unique jewelry pieces. Grateful to his many supporters, Chris understands that it takes a village to build something beautiful. As a business student, he understood early that hard work and dedication would be the foundation of everything he built — and perhaps more remarkably, he fearlessly embarked on his own venture despite the challenges and criticism that come with choosing a non-traditional path.

Through lived experience, Chris created real-world, authentic ways of learning as he mastered his trade in action — fusing quality materials, superior craftsmanship, and the unique person who wears each piece. For Chris, the jewelry you choose to wear is meant to both tell your story — and be a part of his.

Frequently asked

Where do your stones come from?

Our stones are sourced worldwide, from a range of countries including Australia, Ethiopia, Afghanistan, and more.

Do you offer a warranty?

Yes — every piece comes with a one-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Damage caused by wear, misuse, or accidents is not covered, and any resulting repairs are at the customer's expense.

Do you offer returns or exchanges?

We offer exchanges within 30 days of purchase. Return shipping is at the customer's expense.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes — we ship to a variety of countries, including Canada, the US, and multiple European countries. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on destination.

Is your jewelry hypoallergenic?

Placeholder — confirm which materials are nickel-free/safe for sensitive skin.

Can I request a custom piece?

Yes — custom work is something we specialize in. Reach out through the contact form above with what you have in mind. A 50% deposit is required on all custom pieces before work begins.
